_comment: The four-tier class system. The tier structure is corroborated by the Fextralife wiki navigation and by launch-week coverage; the specific Renown gates come from one detailed class walkthrough and are therefore source-reported. Exams are taken from the exam proctor in Dagsion.

tiers.name: Base Classes
tiers.unlock: Every unit is assigned one of the two base classes before any certification happens.
tiers.notes: Commoner and Noble are the two base classes; certification is what moves a unit out of them.

sources.label: Fire Emblem Wiki - List of classes

tiers.name: Beginner Classes
tiers.unlock: Available from early in the game; the beginner exam tab opens once you reach Dagsion.
tiers.notes: Five options that each specialise in different weapons. They can be mastered for a permanent ability before moving up.
tiers.conflict: One walkthrough reports the beginner exams unlock automatically at the start of the game; another reports they open shortly after reaching Dagsion. Both are recorded.

sources.label: Fextralife Fortune's Weave Wiki - Classes navigation

tiers.name: Specialty Classes
tiers.unlock: Reported as unlocking at Renown level 4.
tiers.notes: The tier most units spend the early and mid game in. One walkthrough counts eleven specialty classes in the exam list.

sources.label: Fextralife Fortune's Weave Wiki - Classes navigation

tiers.note: The tier exists in two independent sources; the Renown 4 requirement is reported by one walkthrough.

tiers.name: Advanced Classes
tiers.unlock: Reported as unlocking at Renown level 8.
tiers.notes: Some advanced classes are route-specific: Ranger and Troubadour are reachable on Leda, Caladrias and Dragoon on Cai, and Blacksmith on Dietrich.

sources.label: Fextralife Fortune's Weave Wiki - Classes navigation

tiers.note: The tier exists in two independent sources; the Renown 8 requirement is reported by one walkthrough.

tiers.name: Master Classes
tiers.unlock: Listed as a separate tier by the wiki; unlock requirements not recorded in the sources checked.
tiers.notes: A fourth tier exists above Advanced. One overview references higher tiers being unlocked by Renown, quests and class keys.

sources.label: Fextralife Fortune's Weave Wiki - Classes navigation

tiers.name: Divine Classes
tiers.unlock: Not recorded in the sources checked.
tiers.notes: Eight classes are grouped under this heading, including The Avatar, The Blade and The Calamity.

tiers.name: Enemy Only
tiers.notes: Eight classes are recorded as enemy only, including Sea Beast, Mummy and The Darkest Dark.
